python -c "
import re

# Test anchored vs unanchored
pattern_anchored = r'^(.+?) *\ world$'
pattern_unanchored = r'(.+?) *\ world'

test_str = 'hello       world'

print('Anchored:')
m = re.match(pattern_anchored, test_str)
if m:
    print(f'  Captured: {m.group(1)!r}')

print('Unanchored:')
for m in re.finditer(pattern_unanchored, test_str):
    print(f'  Captured: {m.group(1)!r}')
"
